_comment:
Scenario-coverage matrix on top of the steady_state_l008 baseline (results/0903b): same factory (agv07, jobCount=10, agvCount=7, minProcTime=15/maxProcTime=90, minOpsPerJob=5/maxOpsPerJob=8, parkingMethod=single, preDispatchingMethod=fixed, episodeDurationSeconds=30000, arrivalLambda=0.008). Each config adds exactly one or two new stressors on top of that baseline so results are directly comparable to results/0903b (the 'baseline' entry below IS 0903b, included for a same-file reference point). Requires --baselinedrain true on the launch command, same as steady_state_l008.json.

Machine-failure lambdas retuned for this run's 30000s episode (steady_state_l008.json's episode length), not the shorter default used in StochasticBatchConfigs.json: mean TTF ~= WeibullLambda * Gamma(1+1/k), at k=1.5 that factor is ~0.903. low target mean TTF ~= 3x episode (90000) -> WeibullLambda~=100000; high target mean TTF ~= 1x episode (30000) -> WeibullLambda~=33000.

AGV failures are deliberately excluded from this matrix. StochasticConfig.AGVFailuresEnabled / StochasticEventManager.SampleAGVTTF()+SampleAGVRepair() exist, but nothing in AGVController.cs (or anywhere else) actually consumes them -- there is no AGV breakdown/repair state machine, EpisodeRecord.cs even has AGVFailureCount/AGVRepairTime commented out ('Phase 3', never finished). Setting agvFailuresEnabled=true today would silently no-op (sampled TTFs go nowhere) rather than fail loudly, so it would masquerade as a tested disruption while actually being identical to no-AGV-failure. Do not add an AGV-failure config until that feature is actually implemented and unit-tested in isolation.

IMPORTANT: burstArrivalsEnabled/burstSizeMean require the new burst-arrival feature added to StochasticEventManager/FactoryOrchestrator/StochasticConfig/ConfigLoader (uncommitted as of this file's creation) -- mf_low/mf_high need no code change and can run against the current linux_server build; l008_burst/l008_mf_high_burst need that build recompiled first, or they will silently run as if burstArrivalsEnabled were absent (defaults to false, single-job arrivals) rather than fail loudly.

configs._comment: Reference point -- identical to steady_state_l008.json / results/0903b. No new stressor.
configs.name: l008_baseline

configs._comment: Machine failures, low disruption -- mean TTF ~3x episode length (~1 failure per 3 episodes per machine).
configs.name: l008_mf_low

configs._comment: Machine failures, high disruption -- mean TTF ~1x episode length (roughly 1 failure per machine per episode).
configs.name: l008_mf_high

configs._comment: Burst arrivals -- 'many jobs at once'. Same event rate (arrivalLambda=0.008) as baseline, but each arrival event now injects a compound-Poisson cluster averaging 3 jobs (1 + Poisson(2)) instead of exactly 1, so realized job throughput is roughly 3x baseline while the event cadence is unchanged. REQUIRES rebuilt linux_server binary (new StochasticEventManager.SampleBurstSize code path).
configs.name: l008_burst

configs._comment: Compound stressor -- high machine failures + bursty arrivals together. REQUIRES rebuilt linux_server binary.
configs.name: l008_mf_high_burst
